description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create a token copy of Godo that is a 5/5 artifact creature with haste.
Put the oldest Godo into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Godo token enters the battlefield, its first ability, Gonti's Aether Heart and Decoction Module trigger.
Resolve the Godo trigger, searching your library for an Equipment and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Declare the Godo token as an attacker. The token triggers, causing you to untap it and all Samurai you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
